response.sql:
WITH nationality_counts AS (
  SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
    ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(result_record_count * 1.0) AS average_record_count
  FROM nationality_counts
), nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT c.nationality,
         SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
         COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
    ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT nt.nationality,
       nt.total_points,
       nt.result_record_count,
       nt.result_record_count - oa.average_record_count AS difference_from_average
FROM nationality_totals AS nt
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY nt.nationality;

assumptions.assumption: The average is the unweighted mean of the number of constructor result records per nationality, counting nationalities represented in constructors even if they have no result records; NULL points are ignored by SUM.
